Name: (CP) Dacar style portraits for Jean and Jorts
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
I got paid to do this and boy oh boy I thought it was going to be a quick in between RSV but it endep up [i]not [/i]being that cause of the tails. Even then, worth it cause cats = good in my book.

[size=2]
Jean and Jorts made in my style! I got comm not too long ago to do these lovely talking cats and cause I can't stop scope creeping myself I had to animate them too. For now they won't move but once the framework for that comes out they will just like Lucikiel! RSV is still being worked on (In the video you can see all that are animated, not all done cause I still need to animate some already done) so don't worry!

[b][color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/color]
[color=#00ff00]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.[/color]
[color=#00ff00]In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:[/color]
[color=#00ff00]"active": "HDP" [/color]
[color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/b][/size]
